o.text: Borrowed from Arabic مَغْلُوبِيَّة (maḡlūbiyya). By surface analysis, məğlub + -iyyət.
From Arabic إِيفَاء (ʔīfāʔ). Sense 2 is possibly a semantic loan from Russian исполне́ние (ispolnénije).
From Proto-Turkic *yẹ̄miĺčen. Cognate with Turkmen ýemşen (“hawthorn”).
